mentions.name: CNC DXF box generator (Flet app)
mentions.description: This app, built with Flet, generates DXF files for CNC projects with drawn previews. It is currently in a working state for rabbet joinery boxes with a sliding lid (or with the lid omitted), with a hinged lid option and an improved, more accurate wireframe preview planned next.
mentions.source_excerpt: Since the 1.0 announcement for flet.dev I have been working on making small apps to make DXF files for CNC projects with drawn previews.
mentions.author: WillAdams
